translations.web: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
translations.bsb: But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
translations.asv: And he saith unto them, Let us go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also; for to this end came I forth.
